key_findings.finding: Established, stable payment entity: card1=8218 has 71 prior transactions with 69 on the same addr1, indicating consistent historical use rather than a burst/new-account pattern.
Entity has zero mature fraud history and no gang signal: prior_fraud_rate=0% and gang_score=0, with low fan-out (3 addr / 4 email / 1 device).
All categorical attributes carry at- or below-baseline fraud rates (overall ~3.5%): ProductCD=W 2.06%, mastercard 3.51%, debit 2.4%. No feature elevates risk.
No risk rules were triggered on this transaction.

A confirmed-fraud similar case exists at the identical $117 amount and similar W/mastercard/debit profile (CASE_001), but its entity was different and thin (34 priors); the drivers of confirmed fraud in the case set (high entity fraud rate 78%, fan-out 10 in CASE_003) are absent here, so surface similarity does not transfer.
The independent evidence corroborates the low GBDT score (p=0.0008); no conflict between model and evidence.

gang_association.rationale: gang_score=0, entity fraud rate 0%, and low fan-out across addr/email/device provide no indication of coordinated/batch fraud activity.

report.disposition_rationale: Low fraud probability across independent signals (clean established entity, below-baseline categorical rates, no rules, no gang evidence) plus a small $117 amount. Expected cost of any review/decline exceeds expected fraud loss, so approve.
report.summary: Transaction 3494710 ($117, ProductCD=W, mastercard/debit) originates from a well-established entity (card1=8218) with 71 prior transactions, 69 on the same address, zero mature fraud history, zero gang score, and low fan-out. All categorical attributes sit at or below the ~3.5% overall base rate. Although one confirmed-fraud similar case shares the exact $117 amount and profile, it belonged to a different, thin entity and lacked this entity's clean track record; the actual drivers of confirmed fraud in the comparison set are absent here. The independent evidence corroborates the very low GBDT score. Recommendation: approve.
